SPACE EXPLORATION This series is focused on the new and exciting mod: Space Exploration by Earendel combined with the live integration with Twitch events through the TVC API by Timbo007up. 
*   Space Exploration mod allows you to leave the planet and build in orbit and settle new planets 
*   Movement is limited to the sacred path i.e. only on concrete (donations give concrete) 
*   Heavy focus on logistics through vehicles i.e. no miners or requester chests (vehicles limited by supporters) 
*   AAI Vehicles allow full automation of vehicles for transport

After you launch a rocket you start discovering new planets, moons, asteroid belts, and other stars. You build an expansive space station as your main research facility, explore new planets and moons, outpost for special resources, and gradually progress into the darkness of deep space as you expand your interstellar empire. A space Exploration game is long. Early game is characterised with basic sciences on your homeworld and launching a satellite rocket into space. Mid game has you building a research space station, exploring new planets looking for strategic resources, and getting started on the 4 specialist science packs. You have 4 types of specialist science to choose from, your decision can be based solely on the techs you want, but may also be influenced by the strategic resources you have discovered so far. Late game leads you to deep space, expanding an interstellar empire, and working on the complexities of deep space science. Finally you gain the ability to escape the stellar cluster and win the game.
